SB.title: RSC Applied Polymers 2026, Scheme 1
SB.scope: SBA / SBMA / SBAA / SBMAA; standard spacer 3. Other spacers are enumerated homologues.

CB.title: CBMA, CBAA and CBMAA synthesis definitions
CB.scope: Acrylamide versus methacrylamide distinction. Exact spacer is recorded separately; source ITP supplies the spacer-3 reference graph.

PB.title: Trialkylammonio alkyl hydrogen phosphate phosphobetaines
PB.scope: Phosphate-type N+-(CH2)n-O-P(=O)(O-)-OH head motif, as confirmed by the user. Polymerizable combinations are enumerated derivatives, not all independently literature-verified monomers.

sulfabetaine.title: Sulfabetaine monomers and polymers (2019)
sulfabetaine.scope: Sulfate ester head, distinct from sulfobetaine sulfonate; methacrylate and methacrylamide architectures. Additional homologues are enumerated derivatives.

PC.title: MPC / 2-methacryloyloxyethyl phosphorylcholine
PC.scope: Exact MPC structure for ester + alpha-methyl. Other linker/backbone combinations are explicitly labelled derivatives.

TMAO.title: TMAO-derived acrylamide monomer (2019)
TMAO.scope: Oxidized dimethylaminopropyl acrylamide; N+-O- direct bond. Other backbones/linkers are derivatives.
